Compute the GWP100 for each of the three candidate mixtures, identify which candidates satisfy GWP100 <= 150, and record each candidate's GWP100 numerically with record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"Read the simulation documentation or simulation-output documents describing time resolution as a function of mixture and gas gap. Extract or compute the predicted time resolution for each GWP-compliant candidate over the allowed 1-3 mm gap range."},{"id":"s4","description":"For each GWP-compliant candidate, determine the gas gap in the 1-3 mm range that gives the best time resolution. Record the best gap and corresponding time resolution numerically with record_results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare the best valid options against the hard requirement of time resolution <= 1.5 ns. Select the option with the smallest predicted time resolution among those satisfying both GWP100 <= 150 and 1 <= gap <= 3 mm, and prepare the single recommended mixture and gas gap for the reporting module."}]}
